name: ROS 2
summary: Open-source middleware, libraries and tools for building robot applications, with a publish/subscribe communication layer and a large package ecosystem. Distributions are released yearly; even-year releases are long-term support.

knowledge.rationale: ROS 2 primarily defines how robot software components communicate (messages, services, actions).

version.label: Lyrical Luth (LTS), released 22 May 2026, supported to May 2031

licenses.name: Apache License 2.0 (core client library rclcpp)
licenses.reviewNote: As granted by the licence text; dependencies and third-party components not assessed. Not legal advice.

limitations.text: docs.ros.org blocks automated retrieval; the Lyrical release date comes from a third-party listing, and its LTS status from the Gazebo compatibility documentation.
Packages in the ROS ecosystem carry their own licences; only the core client library licence is recorded here.

engineeringUses: Connecting perception, planning and control components of a robot through typed messages
Running the same robot software against a simulator or the real robot through standard interfaces
